hooks.command: [ -f todos/todos.db ] && n=$(node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/todos.mjs" count open 2>/dev/null); [ "${n:-0}" != "0" ] && echo "master-brain: ${n} open todo(s): run /mb:todos-list to review or /mb:todos-execute to work them." || true

echo "master-brain · NDA rule (hard constraint, not style): any client-facing deliverable (report, proposal, audit, deck, PDF, email) names ONLY the company that deliverable is FOR. Never name another client anywhere in it: body, headings, tables, figures, captions, footnotes, filenames, metadata. Not even as a benchmark or comparison. Each client is under a separate NDA. Anonymise instead ('another account we run', 'a competitor in the same category') or use public industry data. Cross-client analysis is fine as an internal working file; strip every other client name at the point it becomes a deliverable. Before rendering or sending, grep the deliverable for other client names. When unsure, cut it."

echo "master-brain · delivery rule (two passes, in this order): (1) SUBSTANCE: run the anti-slop pass over any prose you produce (marketing copy, reports, emails, blog drafts, deliverables): /slop-review to find defects, /slop-rewrite to repair only what it lists, /slop-verify for citations, links and package names, /slop-code for code, tests and docs. It reports defects, never authorship. (2) STYLE: then pass the repaired text through the humanizer skill (mb:humanizer / /humanizer) so it reads human-written. Substance before style: stripping style markers off an unsourced paragraph only removes the warning label. Skip both only for code, raw data, or when the user asks for verbatim output."

echo "master-brain · report scoring rule: every client-facing report opens with a score out of 100. Page 1 of the body, right after the cover, before any prose: the overall score with its letter rank (A 90+, B 80+, C 60+, D 40+, F under 40), one graded row per dimension with its own score and printed weight, the overall stated as their weighted average, and one line naming the dimension dragging it down. The number must be reconstructible, not felt: each dimension starts at 100 and loses points only to findings that appear in the report body (Critical 25, High 15, Medium 7, Low 3), a dimension holding an unresolved Critical caps at 60, a dimension that could not be measured is marked 'no data' and dropped from the weighting (never scored 0), and the deduction ledger goes in the appendix so the badge is auditable. Full contract: ~/.claude/skills/master-brain/references/report-scorecard.md. This scores the client's asset, not the prose; it is a different axis from anti-slop, which emits no score by design."
